name: pattern_volume:log-email-app-info
query:
fetch logs, from: -7d, samplingRatio: 100
| filter service.name == "email" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "INFO"
| fieldsAdd sift.pattern = if(matchesPhrase(content, "Sent confirmation to user"), "log-email-app-info-sent-confirmation-to-1f3c", else: "other")
| summarize records = count() * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio), content_chars = sum(stringLength(content)) * takeAny(dt.system.sampling_ratio), by:{sift.pattern}
